tool_args.rationale: The open-branch measurements vary s_grad and show a gradient-dependent response while the u_now trend is concave. Fit the compact two-layer siphon saturation with a square-root branch numerically to all seven paid rows; no oscillatory or temporal evidence warrants more probes.

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The observations all use H=0.6 and do not show a trajectory/time signature; additional trajectory data are not the most direct way to address the small residual miss.
Already acquired; its gradient-varied rows establish a sink effect, so repeating it is less useful than fitting the corresponding mechanism.
Gradient-varied responses indicate that a model ignoring s_grad is inadequate.
No horizon variation or trajectory evidence supports these higher-complexity mechanisms.
